question: An autopsy is restricted to examining only the brain and thoracic organs to determine cause of death.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Incorrect. An autopsy is a comprehensive, systematic examination of the whole body — external and all internal organs — not limited to any subset of systems.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — the autopsy is the systematic examination of the entire body, integrating findings across all organ systems to establish cause, manner, and mechanism of death.
